title: Prevent duplicate signup with same email
description: Users should not be able to sign up with an email that already exists. Show friendly error message instead of creating duplicate accounts.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Check if email exists in Better Auth user table before sending magic link
If email exists, show message: 'This email is already registered. Please sign in instead.'
Add link to /login page from error message
Signup form stays on page (doesn't redirect) when email exists
NEVER delete or modify existing user data - only prevent new duplicates
Verify in browser: try signing up with existing email, see error

notes:
⚠️ CRITICAL: PROTECT EXISTING USER DATA

UserId k572fk152njnp9g621kc64bq4x7zgbyt has migrated data - DO NOT:
- Delete any user records without checking their data first
- Run any cleanup that could affect existing users
- Modify the users table structure in ways that lose data

This fix should ONLY:
- Block new signups with existing emails
- Show friendly error message
- Redirect to login

Implementation options:

1. Client-side check before submit:
```typescript
const { data: existingUser } = await authClient.checkEmail({ email });
if (existingUser) {
  setError('This email is already registered');
  return;
}
```

2. Server-side in Convex:
```typescript
const existing = await ctx.db.query('user').withIndex('email', q => q.eq('email', email)).first();
if (existing) throw new ConvexError('Email already registered');
```

3. Better Auth might handle this automatically - check their docs first.
